generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of Monsoon plantation at 1. Mohishet Sy No 53, 54 & Fs No 10, 83 23, 2.Gunji29,73,74,79 & Fs No 35 Londa Range

itemList.description:
Survey and Demarcation of Planting Areas : Survey and
demarcation of plantation boundary lines after clearing
the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas width:-
Sparse under growth.

Aligning in the planting area along to the contours and
marking for pit (without staking)

Excavation of pits with vertically cut edges to make an
uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top
soil on the upper side and 2/3rd on the lower side)
Ordinary soil = Pits of size 0.60m x 0.60m x 0.60m = 400
Pits / Ha

Refilling of pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower
side and refilling 75% or 100% of the pit as the case may
be with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods and
arranging the remaining soil on the lower slope.

Loading and unloading of Polythene / HDPE Bagged
Seedlings: Loading of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings
into vehicle at the nursery site and unloading at the site
nearest to the planting site -Seedlings raised in 8" x 12"
size bags.

Transportation of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings in
vehicle from nursery site to planting site. Seedlings
raised in 8" x 12" size bags :Distance from 21 to 30 Kms.

Conveyance of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings as head
loads from the dumping site to planting location near each
trench / pits (distance up to 3 Km.)-8" x 12" size bagged
seedlings.

Watering polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings at planting
site by dipping in water (including carrying of water)
only in dry conditions of weather.-8" x 12" size bagged
seedlings.

Planting of polythene / HDPE bags seedlings after tearing
with blade and removing the polythene / HDPE bags in
trenches / pits including scooping the soil to required
depth and pressing the soil gently around the seedlings
after planting.8" x 12" size bagged seedlings.
Purchase of 12x14 guage good quality GI Barbed wire

Preparation of fence posts, duly fashioned conical at the
top, debarked and tar coated complete; 2 m length and 38
cm Girth (Wooden post material should be obtained from
dead timber material already available in forest areas or
by singling out of forked poles of appropriate size and
not by cutting live tree).

Transportation of fence posts up to 10 km distance
including loading and unloading charges using hired
vehicle.

Fixing the fence posts after digging pits of 30 cm x 30 cm
x 40 cm depth and consolidation, ensuring firm fixture.
Cost of "U" nails

Unrolling and fixing barbed wire with 'U' nails in four
rows, ensuring proper fixture. (excludes cost of wire and
'U' nails).
Purchase of DAP (50 grams per plant)

Application of chemical fertilizers around the plants
about 15 cm. away in a furrow duly covering with soil
(excluding the cost of fertilizer). (2 times)

First weeding around the plants (pits) to a radius of 60
cm.

Hoeing and soil working with pickaxe around the plant to a
depth of 15cm. and to a radius of 60 cm. so as to loosen
the soil around the plants (pits only).

Scraping of grass and other weed growth around the plant
(Pits) (Scraping item is allowed only in grass-infested
areas) 60 cm. radius around the plant.

Engaging casual labour for watch & ward and protection of
the plantation as per the standard norms.( for 25 Ha. as
unit during the year) and pro-rate for different extent
for the actual period) from 1-7-2026 to 31-3-2027

Fire Protection work in Plantations: New Fire Lines:
Cutting of all existing weed growth to a width of 3 m.
heaping, burning and re- burning in younger plantations.

Procurement Bamboo seedlings raised in 8"x12" Polythene
bags
Miscellaneous & rounding off
